01 — How we operate

How Caretaker operates

Good security is a complete system: vetted officers, professional supervision and a response network that stays alert around the clock.

From a single property to a nationwide contract, every assignment is shaped around your site, your risk profile and the way you work.

02 — What we cover

Core services

Four core disciplines, plus specialist capability for assignments that need more.

  1. 01

    Manned guarding

    Armed and unarmed officers, vetted and trained before deployment, with layered supervision for your site.

    Discuss manned guarding
  2. 02

    Alarm monitoring & response

    Wired and wireless alarm systems connected to a staffed control room and zoned Quick Reaction Force vehicles.

    Discuss alarm monitoring
  3. 03

    Fire safety

    Fire equipment supply, installation, inspection and servicing, supported by risk surveys and emergency response.

    Discuss fire safety
  4. 04

    Cash management

    Accountable teller services, secure vaulting and cash-in-transit operations for your business.

    Discuss cash management

Prepared before deployment

Screening & training

Every officer completes screening, training and formal commissioning before reaching a client site.

  • Identity & residence verification
  • Police, CID & local council checks
  • Written, verbal & physical assessment
  • Qualifications & health screening
  • Entry control, screening & patrol training
  • Bodyguard responsibilities & suspect detention

Continuous training. Consistent professional standards.
